title: Tenses Rewrite
description: Sentence transformation exercises for English tenses.

questions.original: The last time she had a swim was ten years ago.
questions.answer: She hasn't had a swim for ten years.

questions.original: I have never met such a famous person before.
questions.answer: It is the first time I have met such a famous person.

questions.original: I last saw him when I was a student.
questions.answer: I haven't seen him since I was a student.

questions.original: I haven't come there for two years.
questions.answer: I last came there two years ago.

questions.original: I have studied English for seven years.
questions.answer: I started studying English seven years ago.

questions.original: I last met him in September.
questions.answer: I haven't met him since September.

questions.original: She hasn't written to him since last summer.
questions.answer: She last wrote to him last summer.

questions.original: He hasn't come back to his home village for over 20 years now.
questions.answer: It's over 20 years since he came back to his home village.

questions.original: The last time we met each other was ten years ago.
questions.answer: We haven't met each other for ten years.

questions.original: Have you ever played a computer game before?
questions.answer: Is this the first time you have played a computer game?

questions.original: People speak English here.
questions.answer: English is spoken here.

questions.original: Nguyen Du wrote Kieu's story.
questions.answer: Kieu's story was written by Nguyen Du.

questions.original: Someone was cleaning the classroom when I came.
questions.answer: The classroom was being cleaned when I came.

questions.original: She will send him a gift on his birthday.
questions.answer: He will be sent a gift on his birthday.

questions.original: People believe that 13 is an unhappy number.
questions.answer: It is believed that 13 is an unhappy number.

questions.original: This factory is producing more and more pollution.
questions.answer: More and more pollution is being produced by this factory.

questions.original: No one has signed the cheque.
questions.answer: The cheque hasn't been signed.

questions.original: The manager had his secretary prepare the report.
questions.answer: The manager had the report prepared by his secretary.

questions.original: I am going to get Harry to repair my car.
questions.answer: I am going to get my car repaired by Harry.

questions.original: They used to make little boys climb the chimneys to clean them.
questions.answer: Little boys used to be made to climb the chimneys to clean them.

questions.original: He left school because his life was hard.
questions.answer: Because of his hard life, he left school.

questions.original: John succeeded in his exam because of his hard and methodical work.
questions.answer: Because John worked hard and methodically, he succeeded in his exam.

questions.original: We didn't want to go out because of the heavy rain.
questions.answer: Because it was raining heavily, we didn't want to go out.

questions.original: Although he had much experience in machinery, he didn't succeed in repairing this machine.
questions.answer: Despite his much experience in machinery, he didn't succeed in repairing this machine.

questions.original: In spite of the darkness, they continued to work.
questions.answer: Though it was dark, they continued to work.

questions.original: We postponed our trip because the driving conditions were bad.
questions.answer: Because of the bad driving conditions, we postponed our trip.

questions.original: The water in most rivers is unsafe to drink because it is polluted.
questions.answer: Because of pollution, the water in most rivers is unsafe to drink.

questions.original: We all have received the best of everything because of our generous parents.
questions.answer: Because our parents are generous, we have all received the best of everything.

questions.original: The weather was so bad that all the flights had to be cancelled.
questions.answer: It was such bad weather that all the flights had to be cancelled.

questions.original: The test wasn't easy enough for them to do.
questions.answer: The test was too difficult for them to do.

questions.original: The play we saw yesterday was so long that we couldn't finish it in an hour.
questions.answer: We saw such a long play yesterday that we couldn't finish it in an hour.

questions.original: These goods are so expensive that they can't be sold quickly.
questions.answer: These goods are too expensive to be sold quickly.

questions.original: He studied too badly to pass his exam.
questions.answer: He didn't study enough to pass his exam.

questions.original: My friend is very strong. He can lift up the table by himself.
questions.answer: My friend is so strong that he can lift up the table by himself.

questions.original: I ate a lot of sandwiches. I felt uneasy.
questions.answer: I ate so many sandwiches that I felt uneasy.

questions.original: Tom is still too young to join the police.
questions.answer: Tom isn't old enough to join the police.

questions.original: We lower the volume of the radio. We don't want to bother our neighbors.
questions.answer: We lower the volume of the radio so that we don't bother our neighbors.

questions.original: Please shut the door. I don't want the dog to go out of the house.
questions.answer: Please shut the door so that the dog doesn't go out of the house.

questions.original: He climbed the tree in order to get a better view.
questions.answer: He climbed the tree so that he could get a better view.

questions.original: I am going to be very careful so that I won't have an accident.
questions.answer: I am going to be very careful to avoid having an accident.

questions.original: I wore boots because I didn't want my feet to get wet.
questions.answer: I wore boots so as not to get my feet wet.

questions.original: Hurry up or we will be late for the last bus.
questions.answer: If you don't hurry up, we will be late for the last bus.

questions.original: I regret that you didn't give me a chance to tell you the truth.
questions.answer: I wish you had given me a chance to tell you the truth.

questions.original: It was very cold yesterday, so we couldn't go swimming.
questions.answer: If it hadn't been very cold yesterday, we could have gone swimming.

questions.original: You talk more than you work. The teacher wishes
questions.answer: The teacher wishes you would work more than you talk.

questions.original: He had a flu because he went out in the rain last night.
questions.answer: If he hadn't gone out in the rain last night, he wouldn't have had a flu.

questions.original: Ellen didn't have much money in the bank, so she was very worried.
questions.answer: If Ellen had had much money in the bank, she wouldn't have been very worried.

questions.original: Stop talking or you won't understand the lesson.
questions.answer: Unless you stop talking, you won't understand the lesson.

questions.original: Why don't you study hard?
questions.answer: If you studied hard, you would succeed.

questions.original: I'd like to buy this book but I don't have money to buy it.
questions.answer: If only I had money to buy this book.

questions.original: She can't buy the dictionary because she doesn't have enough money.
questions.answer: If she had enough money, she could buy the dictionary.

questions.original: This is Rex hotel and it is the biggest hotel in the city.
questions.answer: This is the biggest hotel in the city, which is Rex hotel.

questions.original: The dog was very frightened. The boys threw stones at it.
questions.answer: The dog, which the boys threw stones at, was very frightened.

questions.original: There wasn't any directory in the telephone box. I was phoning from this box.
questions.answer: The telephone box that I was phoning from didn't have any directory.

questions.original: Her father died last year. She looked after him for over twenty years.
questions.answer: Her father, whom she looked after for over twenty years, died last year.

questions.original: Do you remember the day? We first met on that day.
questions.answer: Do you remember the day when we first met?

questions.original: John said to his mother "I don't know how to do this exercise".
questions.answer: John told his mother that he didn't know how to do that exercise.

questions.original: "Push as hard as you can" She said to me.
questions.answer: She told me to push as hard as I could.

questions.original: "Don't wait for me if I am late" He said to her.
questions.answer: He told her not to wait for him if he was late.

questions.original: "Where are you from, Nam?" said Mai.
questions.answer: Mai asked Nam where he was from.

questions.original: Mary said "I cannot go to the cinema with you, John".
questions.answer: Mary told John that she couldn't go to the cinema with him.

questions.original: Tom asked Mary "Did you phone me last night?".
questions.answer: Tom asked Mary if she had phoned him the night before.

questions.original: He asked me "Why didn't you go to school yesterday?".
questions.answer: He asked me why I hadn't gone to school the day before.

questions.original: "Why don't you stop smoking?" the doctor said to him.
questions.answer: The doctor advised him to stop smoking.

questions.original: "How many students are there in your class?"
questions.answer: The man asked me how many students there were in my class.

questions.original: "Have you seen John recently?" said Ann.
questions.answer: Ann asked me if I had seen John recently.
